'''''Artemisia verlotiorum''''', the '''Chinese mugwort''', is a species of plant in the [[Asteraceae|sunflower family]], widespread across much of [[Eurasia]].<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=200023364 Flora of China, <big>南艾蒿</big> nan ai hao ''Artemisia verlotorum'' Lamotte, Mém. Assoc. Franç. Congr. Clermont Ferrand. 1876: 511. 1876. ]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=artemisia+verlotiorum Altervista Flora Italiana, Assenzio dei fratelli Verlot, ''Artemisia verlotiorum'' Lamotte]</ref>

==Etymology==
It is named for Jean Baptiste [[Verlot]], who first distinguished the plant from ''[[Artemisia vulgaris]]'' in 1877 and for his brother Pierre Bernard Verlot, and is sometimes referred to as Verlot's Mugwort.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Chemical Constituents of ''Artemisia verlotiorum'' Essential Oil on Cultivation at the Subtropical Conditions of North India|journal=Journal of Essential Oil Research|date=Sep–Oct 2006|first=F.|last=Haider |author2=A.A. Naqvi |author3=G.D. Bagchi|volume=18 |issue=5 |pages=551–552 |doi=10.1080/10412905.2006.9699164 |s2cid=95887293 |url=https://dx.doi.org/10.1080/10412905.2006.9699164|access-date=2008-01-18 |url-access=subscription }}</ref>

==Description==
It has oblong reddish to brown capitula, its stems are green and the leaves broader, lighter colored and denser on the stem. The plant is more strongly and pleasantly aromatic than ''[[Artemisia vulgaris]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ienica.net/crops/artemisia.htm |title=Artemisia |access-date=2011-02-16 |work=IENICA Database |publisher=IENICA}}</ref> It flowers very late in the summer, but reproduces mainly by [[stolons]], thus forming thick groups. Chinese Mugwort shares the same habitat as ''Artemisia vulgaris'', and both are very common.

''Artemisia verlotiorum'' is often confused with ''Artemisia vulgaris'' ("common mugwort"), which is closely related.<ref>[http://www.bgbm.org/willdenowia/w-pdf/w26Gabrielian+VallesXirau.pdf Eleonora Gabrielian & Joan Vallès Xirau: New Data about the Genus ''Artemisia'' L. (Asteraceae) in Armenia. Willdenowia Bd. 26, H. 1/2 (Nov. 29, 1996), pp. 245-250.]  {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110615181843/http://www.bgbm.org/willdenowia/w-pdf/w26Gabrielian%2BVallesXirau.pdf |date=June 15, 2011 }}</ref>
